segments.name: Software
segments.description: Supplies simulation, modeling and AI-driven prediction software to biopharmaceutical clients for drug discovery, development, clinical trials and commercialization.
segments.evidence: Software: Supports pharmaceutical research, development, and commercialization through simulation, modeling, and AI-driven prediction.

segments.name: Services
segments.description: Provides scientific consulting in pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, drug modeling and regulatory strategy to biopharma clients from discovery through clinical development.
segments.evidence: Its scientists and engineers specialize in pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, drug modeling, and regulatory strategy, supporting clients from discovery through clinical development.

revenueModel.text: Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, agrochemical, cosmetics and food companies, plus academic and regulatory agencies, pay for software licenses and scientific consulting services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our software and consulting services are provided to major pharmaceutical, biotechnology, agrochemical, cosmetics, and food industry companies and academic and regulatory agencies worldwide for use in conducting industry-based research.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025 the company reorganized its internal structure, replacing its former reporting units with Software and Services reporting units.
changes.evidence: At the beginning of the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2025, the Company reorganized its internal structure to create a more integrated and cohesive operating platform based on product and service solutions.
